proposal.headline: Raise the Jurassic–Cretaceous contact to expose low northeastern terrain
proposal.observation: The observed northeastern side is predominantly Jurassic, whereas the prediction places Cretaceous across that area. Cretaceous on the southwestern side already agrees substantially with the target.
proposal.expected_effect: Expose Jurassic across the lower northeastern terrain while retaining Cretaceous on higher southwestern ground, without changing the older fold core.
